name: VAG DQ250 6-speed DSG (02E, PQ35/PQ46) - Temic TCU J743
notes: Controller view of the 02E mechatronic. Flash layout, maps and checksum live in the two ecudefs (one per software generation): temic-dq250-02e (PowerPC, dq250-02e checksum real-image-tested 78/78, 30 shift tables MEDIUM) and temic-dq250-02e-tricore (no checksum). Diagnostics: neither channel is confirmed for 02E; PQ-era workshop diagnostics commonly run KWP2000 over VW TP2.0. See docs/DSG.md.

diagnostics.name: kwp-isotp
diagnostics.notes: OBD transmission ids, as in the ecudef; not confirmed for 02E.

diagnostics.name: tp20
diagnostics.notes: VAG gearbox logical address; open with --opt transport=tp20 --opt tp20_addr=0x02 on a raw-CAN driver. Not tried on a car.

safety: A DSG TCU controls clutch pressure. Wrong shift or clutch data can damage the clutches or the gearbox and can make a car move unexpectedly. Edit by ratio, keep downshift points below their upshift points, and keep a verified stock read.
Only calibration editing is in scope: no launch-control, torque-limiter or protection defeat.
Bench reads: current-limited supply, fused +12 V, CAN terminated (see the database unit).

sources.title: OpenTune's own analysis of real 02E reads (docs/DSG.md)
sources.used_for: layout, checksum and maps (in the linked ecudefs)
